answer: Bind each identity to one physical device through a hardware attestation key baked into its secure enclave, so a karst of cheap virtual clones collapses into a single provable machine. New identities then enter a shared lagoon of staked funds: to earn, an agent locks a deposit that only unlocks after months of verified useful work, and any fraud proof drains it. Reputation grows like a willow, slowly branching only through completed, independently checked tasks, so forging a thousand fake identities costs a thousand devices plus a thousand locked deposits, while one honest agent pays once.
